name: AirTrunk SYD2 phase 4 (Shell C)

address.value: 1 Sirius Road, Lane Cove West NSW 2066

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 1 SIRIUS ROAD LANE COVE WEST; the service returns two address points for this address (-33.80614,151.14840 and -33.80779,151.14472); first used. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

builder.note: DPHI letter 23 Dec 2025 approving updated CEMP 'prepared by AW Edwards Pty Ltd, dated 13 September 2025' and 'SYD2 CNVMP Update for MOD3 SSDA Construction Certificate Issue'; AW Edwards CEMP revision register (source 11): 'B 13-Sep-25 For Construction ... Revised Issue (Building C)'

mw_it.note: DERIVED, not stated by any source: AirTrunk's 70 MW for 'the final two phases' (source 1) minus phase 3's 30 MW (source 3). Approximate: topping-out release said phase 3 'adds more than 30MW' (source 4). No primary source gives phase 4 / Shell C MW

mw_grid.note: consent capacity 138 MW is for the whole SSD-9741 building (all four phases); see airtrunk-syd2

cost_aud_m.note: no separate CIV per phase: phases 3-4 are within SSD-9741 (whole-building CIV $196.9m, see airtrunk-syd2); Mod 3 made no change to CIV

authority.value: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (DPHI)
authority.note: Mod 3 determined by Director under delegation

pathway.note: phases 3 and 4 are part of the original SSD-9741 consent (four-phase building, determined 15 Nov 2019); Mod 3 changed the design for the remaining phases (shared by phase 3 and phase 4 records)

reference.note: parent consent SSD-9741 (determined 15 Nov 2019). Mod 3 'Design Changes': max height increase, data halls 18 to 20, chillers 106 to 108, transformers/generators 116 to 121; capacity 138 MW unchanged. Oct 2020 exhibition EXH-9395018 was Mod 2 (2 Apollo Place office), not this expansion

lodged.note: Mod 3 AR: 'The application was lodged on 14 February 2023'

determined.note: portal Determination Date 13/06/2024. Construction of the expansion started June 2023, before Mod 3 was determined, presumably under the existing SSD-9741 consent

jobs_construction.note: no per-phase figure; whole-SSD 'Approximately 320 direct construction jobs' recorded on airtrunk-syd2

jobs_operational.note: no per-phase figure; whole-campus figures on airtrunk-syd2

construction_start.note: AirTrunk 15 Jun 2023: 'Construction commences for the final two phases of SYD2 campus'. AirTrunk's timeline (source 2) lists only Shell D commencing (May 2023); AW Edwards issued a revised CEMP for Building C on 13 Sep 2025 (source 11), approved by DPHI 23 Dec 2025 (source 7), so main Shell C works may have started later (c. late 2025)

construction_end.note: not found. AirTrunk timeline 'Apr 2026 Current site with Shell C under construction' (source 2). Original target was completion in 2024 (source 1)

open_questions: phase 4 (Shell C) IT MW not stated by any source; 40 MW is derived (70 - 30)
phase 4 construction start ambiguous: June 2023 (two-phase announcement) vs Building C CEMP revision Sep 2025
